Return Tracking

Every Return and RTO from Meesho, Flipkart, Myntra and Amazon, taken live from the Tracker sheets. Each box starts as NO (red) and turns YES (green) once the parcel is back with you. Click the box to switch.

Purchase Records

A plain record of what we bought: item, amount and date of purchase. This is for our records only. Nothing here is deducted from, or added to, any other tab.

Invoice

Fill in the buyer and items. The tax invoice on the right updates as you type. Use Download PDF to save it as a PDF file, or Print to print it. GST is split into CGST + SGST when the place of supply is the same state as your GST number (Delhi), and IGST for other states.

Payment reminders

Saved invoices (0)

Invoices are saved automatically when you download or print them. Saving again with the same invoice number updates that invoice.

Credit notes / cancellations (0)

Issued invoices are never deleted. Press Cancel on a saved invoice to cancel it with a reason. A credit note is created and linked to the original invoice.

Stock

Type how many pieces of each product you have. You get a warning when a product is at or below its alert level. "New sales" counts orders dated after the day you set the number; tap Apply to subtract them. Saved automatically.

Top 10 Sold Products

Last year and this year side by side. Only real sales are counted: cancelled, Return and RTO orders are left out. Use the filters to look at a whole year or a single month.
